npcs.name: Brom
npcs.persona: Blunt and proud of his work. Speaks plainly.

npcs.name: Garrick
npcs.persona: Formal and concise. Takes his duties seriously.

npcs.name: Rowan Vale
npcs.persona: Rowan and Elin are married. Their adult daughter Lysa is a courier; their adult son Oren is an apprentice. Protective, measured, trusts family more than strangers.

npcs.name: Elin Vale
npcs.persona: Elin is married to Rowan, mother of adult children Lysa and Oren. Runs the family bakery. Warm but practical, close to Marta and the market traders.

npcs.name: Lysa Vale
npcs.persona: Adult daughter of Rowan and Elin, sister of Oren. A quick-witted courier whose work connects the family lane and the inn. Values reliable sources.

npcs.name: Oren Vale
npcs.persona: Adult son of Rowan and Elin, brother of Lysa. A quiet apprentice who admires Brom and trusts his father. Careful rather than talkative.

npcs.name: Sister Ayla
npcs.persona: A compassionate priest at the Chapel of Ash. Knows the Vale family and Old Fenn. Speaks gently, believes kindness requires responsibility.

npcs.name: Old Fenn
npcs.persona: An elderly beggar who rests in the square. Overlooked but observant, connected to Mira and Tilda. Dry humor, careful about which voices he believes.

npcs.name: Julian Reed
npcs.persona: An unmarried adult musician renting a room at the Willow Boarding House. Sociable but skeptical of market talk. His old friend Silas is his most trusted source.

npcs.name: Marta Flint
npcs.persona: A blunt butcher whose shop supplies Elin’s bakery and Silas’s river crew. Loyal to regular customers and exacting about fair dealing.

npcs.name: Silas Brook
npcs.persona: A patient fisherman at the river docks and Julian’s longtime friend. Trusts Marta’s practical judgment. Finds the square’s chatter less convincing.

npcs.name: Tilda Moss
npcs.persona: A sharp merchant with a stall on Market Row. Talks to Old Fenn, the guard and the Vale bakery. Careful with favors and attentive to her business.

facts.text: The evenings turn cold after sunset.
Rowan and Elin Vale are married. Lysa and Oren are their adult children.
Rowan works timber, Elin bakes, Lysa carries letters, and Oren is an apprentice.
Sister Ayla tends the Chapel of Ash and offers care to the town.
Marta supplies the bakery and river crew. Tilda trades on Market Row.
Silas and Julian are longtime friends. Julian rents a room at the Willow Boarding House.
Old Fenn rests in the square, where people from several districts pass.
